overall_summary: Most core romantic/self-respect shorts have very low sample views (under 50), while a brief departure into family emotional content ('Maa', 'Papa', 'Bhai') showed significantly higher views and engagement (up to 203 views). Confidence is low for purely romantic shorts due to low velocity, but family-focused micro-stories or fresh phone-habit angles warrant controlled testing.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about Mother (OfHrAp3r1G8 - 203 views), Father (v8krtdmxbPs - 46 views), and Brother (m4cgM90y9JU - 52 views) outperformed almost all relationship/self-respect shorts.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate occasional family-centric emotional shorts to broaden appeal beyond just heartbreak.

winning_patterns.evidence: AfaLxMy6FMY ('उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी' - 41 views) and W0ozRrwvigQ ('जब आर्काइव फोल्डर पर नजर पड़ी' - 23 views) performed better than abstract emotional concepts.
winning_patterns.action: Use specific, tactile smartphone interface actions for hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing heavily on generic late-night texting anxiety or repetitive unpin/block lines without a strong micro-action got very low traction (e.g., hT4EGP69mRw, cuKSS0gHyt0 with 0-3 views).
weak_patterns.action: Move away from abstract notification anxiety and focus on unique physical items or unexpected moments.
